title: Identification of steroid-induced osteonecrosis of the femoral head biomarkers based on immunization and animal experiments.
summary: GEO cohorts, WGCNA, immune analyses and machine learning nominated ICAM1, NR3C1 and IKBKB; an independent dataset and steroid-induced osteonecrosis animal experiments support the expression and immune findings.
ai_technology: WGCNA and ML hub-gene selection identify three candidate immune-associated biomarkers from SONFH expression data.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: 40-sample GEO discovery cohort plus 8-sample external dataset; animal experiments confirm hub-gene upregulation and immune infiltration association.
evidence.unknown: Independent public cohort plus animal experiments directly test candidate expression, though sample sizes are small and pathogenesis remains mechanistic hypothesis.
evidence.ai_role: WGCNA and ML hub-gene selection identify three candidate immune-associated biomarkers from SONFH expression data.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
